purpose: Mechanism overview with annotated diagram showing internal component layout
prompt:
Industrial design mechanism overview diagram of an elderly AI companion device, technical illustration style on warm cream background (#F5F0E8).

Center: A large cutaway/cross-section view of the pebble-shaped device showing internal component placement. The device is approximately 130mm wide x 170mm tall.

Functional zones clearly labeled with thin leader lines in text-charcoal (#3D3832):

1. TOP ZONE — "LED Ring + Light Guide" — A ring of warm amber LEDs (#E8B87A) at the upper third, surrounded by a frosted translucent diffuser that spreads light evenly. Show the light spreading outward in soft radial gradient.

2. UPPER-MIDDLE — "Microphone Array (3x)" — Three small microphone ports evenly spaced around the upper body, behind the acoustic fabric. Shown as small dots with sound-wave indicators.

3. MIDDLE — "Speaker Driver (40mm)" — A circular speaker driver behind the fabric wrap in the center of the device. Show sound waves emanating outward through the fabric. The fabric is labeled "acoustic-transparent weave."

4. FRONT FACE — "Touch Button (25mm)" — A large circular button on the front, shown with a finger-touch indicator. Connected to a small PCB behind it.

5. BOTTOM — "Wood Base + Charging Contacts" — The light oak wood base (#C4A882) with hidden magnetic charging contacts on the underside. Show the charging puck below with magnetic alignment indicators.

6. INTERNAL — "Mainboard + Battery" — A small PCB and lithium battery visible in the cutaway, positioned in the lower body.

All annotations use text-charcoal (#3D3832) on surface-cream (#F5F0E8). Clean technical illustration style, not photorealistic — more like a patent drawing or design engineering diagram. Warm tones throughout, no cold blue or clinical white.
